Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Shibori Inspired Stoneware Vase, 11.6"H, Blue and White
Colors: Multy
Materials: stoneware
Match this beautiful vase with a bright purple iris or a white rose and place it as a centerpiece on any table. The base diameter of just over 6" gives way to a thin decorative pillar, making this the perfect standalone vase. 6.3" diameter x 11.6"H Made from 100% stoneware for long-lasting durability Suitable for cloth flowers or blossoms straight from the garden White-on-blue Shibori styling makes this vase both eye-catching and unique. No assembly required Hand wash with a damp cloth.
